name: Worker and Sidecar Isolation
description: Web workers and native sidecars run in isolated contexts with defined IPC contracts, resource limits (CPU/memory), and no ambient authority. Sidecar processes are explicitly spawned and managed.
purpose: Prevent worker and sidecar processes from escaping their intended scope by enforcing isolation with defined IPC contracts, resource limits, and no ambient authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Web workers have no access to Node.js APIs or filesystem
Native sidecar processes are explicitly spawned with scoped capabilities
Worker/sidecar IPC contracts are documented and enforced
Resource limits (CPU, memory) are enforced per worker/sidecar
Workers and sidecars cannot escape their sandbox boundaries
Worker/sidecar lifecycle is managed and audited
